name: benchmark-dbpedia
description: A text classification benchmark derived from DBpedia ontology that maps short Wikipedia abstracts to ontology classes. It measures a model's ability to perform multi-class topic/ontology labeling on encyclopedic short-form text and is used to evaluate representation learning and classifier performance. The dataset is compact and well-structured, making it suitable for benchmarking classification architectures and pretrained language models.
reputation: A classic, widely used NLP benchmark for multi-class text classification with broad adoption in research and tutorials.
